scope: current branch official/manual exact same-shape parity
gate_definition: finite, dtype-equal, exact same-shaped official/manual prefill, cached-step and full-replay logits and language inputs; exact positions/masks/cache lengths
diagnostic_definition: official and manual cached-versus-full replay differences are diagnostic only; no numerical tolerance or argmax gate
cached_step_scope: one next-token forward after the recorded prefill continuation token

official_cached_vs_official_full_replay.yes_no_score_scope: next-token candidate scores after the recorded forced/argmax replay token; not the image first-answer score

manual_cached_vs_manual_full_replay.yes_no_score_scope: next-token candidate scores after the recorded forced/argmax replay token; not the image first-answer score
